name: Rangers of Ithilien, Vodalian Mindsinger, Old Man of the Sea, Vedalken Shackles, Seasinger — target words that compare power or ask for an Island
notes: Memory: project_lesser_power_and_island_target_words_2026-10-16. The target words 'with lesser power' (Rangers of Ithilien), 'with power less than [or equal to] this creature's power' (Vodalian Mindsinger, Old Man of the Sea), 'with power less than or equal to the number of Islands you control' (Vedalken Shackles) and 'whose controller controls an Island' (Seasinger) were not in the filter vocabulary, so each became a required subtype: the fired ability's picker listed nothing and a target set anyway was refused by the fire-time check. The power bound is now written out as a number from the fire-time snapshot (Seasinger 0/1, Mindsinger 2/2, Rangers 3/3, Old Man 2/3, one Island of yours when Shackles fires), and 'whose controller controls an Island' asks whether the permanent's controller has one. Seasinger fires before you have an Island, so it is not its own candidate. Each card is fired right after it is added, so its list holds only what came before it.

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

scryfallData.name: Elvish Mystic
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.
